name: smwgraphics-gaia-gensouki-itory-village
title: Gaia Gensouki - Itory Village
description:
The background seen in Itory Village, ripped directly from the japanese version of "Illusion of Gaia". Unlike most games, there is a good ammount of regional differences between the japanese and international releases, one of them being some backgrounds being changed to something different. The original background from Itory Village has the sky clouds moving and parallaxing in the mountains. A great fit for mountain or grassland levels. Part of my C3 2022 Summer thread.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
